description_en: Updates the VPC that is attached to a namespace
description_zh: 调用UpdateNamespaceVpc接口更新命名空间绑定的VPC
name: UpdateNamespaceVpc

parameters.help_en: The long-format namespace ID. If you set this parameter, it takes precedence over NameSpaceShortId. This parameter is for backward compatibility. Use the short-format namespace ID to simplify the request
parameters.help_zh: 长版命名空间ID。如果设置了该参数会继续生效而忽略NameSpaceShortId，该参数是为了兼容保留，推荐使用短版命名空间ID，简化参数
parameters.name: namespace_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC. This VPC replaces the original VPC
parameters.help_zh: VPC ID。用于替换现有的VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The short-format namespace ID. You do not need to include the region ID. We recommend that you use this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 短版命名空间ID，不需要带上region，推荐
parameters.name: name_space_short_id

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code. The value can be a POP error code. Valid values:

2xx: The request was successful.

3xx: The request was redirected.

4xx: The request was invalid.

5xx: A server error occurred
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code.

This parameter is not returned if the request is successful.

This parameter is returned if the request fails. For more information, see the Error codes section of this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request is successful, success is returned.

If the request fails, an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the VPC was updated. Valid values:

true: The VPC was updated.

false: The VPC failed to be updated
Success.description_zh:
更新VPC信息是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：更新成功。
false：更新失败

TraceId.description_en: The trace ID. You can use it to query the details of a call
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息
